title: Logistics Project Manager
description:
**The Company**
 Imerys is the world’s leading supplier of mineral\\-based specialty solutions for the industry with €3\\.8 billion in revenue and 13,700 employees in 54 countries in 2023\\. The Group offers high value\\-added and functional solutions to a wide range of industries and fast\\-growing markets such as solutions for the energy transition and sustainable construction, as well as natural solutions for consumer goods. Imerys draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge, and expertise in material science to deliver solutions which contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance. As part of its commitment to responsible development, Imerys promotes environmentally friendly products and processes in addition to supporting its customers in their decarbonization efforts.
   

  

**The Position**
 Logistics Project Manager
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Role**
 Part Of The Business Area Performance Mineral EMEA (3500 Employees, 80 Plants, 15 Countries \\& 1,2 Billion Euros Revenue), The Logistics Project Manager
   

  

* Is part of the Supply Chain Continuous Improvement \\& Projects teams of the Business Area, focusing on Logistics continuous improvement projects
* Is the point of contact of the business area for wide projects such as Transwide rollout, DBS EDI/interface, transport pre\\-billing,...


 The Logistics Project Manager works hands in hands with the Corporate teams and with the Business Area Logistics colleagues
   

  

* Is referent in his/her field of expertise, ensuring ad hoc training sessions and continuously contributing to the knowledge transfer towards the users


**Responsibilities**
 Project management
   

  

* Leads continuous improvement projects to improve overall efficiency (both qualitative and quantitative) for the BA or be an active stakeholder for transversal projects across Imerys.
* As a referent for the Business Area Performance Minerals EMEA, is the point of contact \\& relay for Corporate projects


 Knowledge sharing \\& skills development
   

  

* Support the logistics colleagues to be sure that the knowledge is well anchored and ensure needed support
* Ensures knowledge sharing across the Business Area by facilitating regular webinars / good practices sharing events
* Interacts beyond the Performance Minerals EMEA perimeter with the other Business Areas to benchmark and identify new solutions
* Maintain logistics optimization expertise and stay up\\-to\\-date with available tools and techniques


 Analysis
   

  

* Perform analysis or Is involved in the preparation of the data collection and analysis to assess, drive and follow up initiatives
* Design and develop optimized logistics plans to achieve costs savings and/or service improvements in collaboration with the Logistics, Corporate teams, Purchasing teams,...
* Develop customer satisfaction by identifying rooms for improvement for our internal stakeholders, customers in collaboration with sales
* Design reporting tools on the efficiency of the Logistics flows and update / share them.


**Accountability**
* Logistic costs saving plans implementation
* Logistics plan implementation \\& update
* Logistics service level monitoring \\& improvement


**Competencies And Experience**
 Key competencies
   

  

* \\>5 years experience in logistics or supply chain positions
* Strong understanding of a logistics organisation
* Continuous improvement mindset and basic tools (5 Whys, Ishikawa, brainstorming, PDCA,A3 …)
* Project management
* Fluent in English, any other language is a plus


 Soft skills
   

  

* Problem solver \\& facilitator
* Very good communication skills with ability to address a topic at different hierarchical levels
* At ease in a matrix environment with cross functional interactions
* Autonomous, comfortable with remote management
* Rigorous \\& at ease with data management
* Capacity to drive change and facilitate change management
* Pedagogic
* Very good analytical \\& IT reasoning skills. (TMS, SAP, Google,...)


 Ideal background/ experience
   

  

* Bachelor or Master with Supply Chain, Logistics or Operations specialization
* Experienced in project management

Michael Page Ingénieurs recrute pour tous types d'entreprises industrielles (start\\-up, PME et grands groupes), des cadres expérimentés sur les métiers liés aux projets, à la R\\&D, à la maintenance, la production, les méthodes, le QHSE et le Lean manufacturing… ainsi que les fonctions de management général (direction d'usine, industrielle, technique) grâce à une équipe d'ingénieurs spécialisés.

 1 jour de télétravail par semaine.

 ,

 ,
